authority: User authorized docs/arbiter/final-plan.md implementation on 15 November 2026; D02/D03/D05/D06/D07 govern this additive protocol.
scope: Research acceptance criteria and draft experiment register only. This file is not a native request, profile, calibration, rights approval, qualification proof or training release.

shipping_policy_amendment.qualification_mapping: New 8192/120 results require exact current native artifact and policy identities; historical T2048/N8/30s results never transfer.
shipping_policy_amendment.work_accounting: Charge all stage prompts, padding, internal reads and retries to the original shared budget and clock; report cold/warm component and end-to-end latency plus failed attempt costs.
shipping_policy_amendment.resource_fit: Measure actual CPU/ISA/provider/threads, input dimensions, load/resident coexistence/RSS/disk peaks, OOM/cancel/recovery; no host or profile transfer.

data_acceptance.split_unit: repository/fork + issue/symbol family + chronology; deduplicate clones, copied documents, fixes and paraphrases before synthesis, mining or scoring
data_acceptance.final_reservation: Reserve unseen projects and task/language slices before synthesis. Entire FINAL source closure is excluded from supervised/unsupervised training and mining. Historical exposed/cancelled FINAL populations stay consumed.
data_acceptance.rights: Pin each actual source revision, source rights/notice artifacts and exact permitted use; benchmark wrapper license alone is insufficient. Hotpot remains evaluation-only.
data_acceptance.visibility: Bind exact original spans to Rust-emitted visible examples; reject invisible positives, preserve extraction/alignment refusals and unknowns in the original denominator.
data_acceptance.annotation: Retain author/authority, uncertainty, original alternatives and all complementary required needs separately. Agent judgment and native span projection do not become human gold.
data_acceptance.negative_masks: Mask known alternative positives and clones; unjudged candidates stay unknown. Keep weak parent bags a distinct equalized-bag-size arm.

acceptance.statistics: Preregister repository-cluster sample/variance/power rationale before scoring; source-cluster paired bootstrap10000 replicates seed1908 confidence.95 remains descriptive, not a substitute for adequate power.
acceptance.baseline_selection: Higher baseline completion; tie fewer mean turns on its own successful tasks; exact tie deterministic_packet. Optional-model results never select the baseline.

terminals.availability: Each class unsupported until independently class-qualified; global whole-roster winner/margin precedes support acceptance; unsupported winner abstains without runner-up fallback.

sufficient.sample_unit: repository/source cluster; independent-binomial guide is insufficient by itself

terminals.labels: Exact class-specific human-adjudicated whole-card evidence and pre-score coverage/risk criteria required. Generic Read reference-gain proxies, QASPER answerability and timeout are not terminal gold.
terminals.clarify: Genuine task ambiguity; no fabricated ambiguity from missing evidence.
terminals.no_justified_read: Complete verified menu and no justified available choice; no claim of global unanswerability.

draft_experiments.abi: exact escaped left-padded512 native pairs; no2152/yes9693 response logits

draft_experiments.controls: original/adapted weights under same instruction and fixed pool, then selected encoder pool
draft_experiments.abi: full-vocabulary response-position yes/no loss, masked prompt, merge before ONNX comparison; overflow remains refused

draft_experiments.controls: unchanged C0 same upstream native view/roster; Focus-off cases included

execution_controls.gradient_release: Blocked until all actual data/input/probe caps above are bound; drafts have no executable max-step/compute authorization.
execution_controls.failed_adaptation: retain exact original weights and continue independent components; original optional weights still require qualification

promotion: Exactly three independently qualified selected optional profiles plus native publication catalog/capture, rights/source maps and final-series local-test refusal. Publication requires separate authorization.
